title: Original multi-control Styles with Amount, descriptions and search
source: rapidroom (original native preset recipes and integration)
notes: Adds ten original looks using luma and RGB channel curves, selective HSL, calibration, grading and restrained finishing. Styles are added once to fresh and existing libraries, with stable IDs preserving favourites and moved presets and a migration marker preserving user deletions. Descriptions are retained and searchable. Amount respects partial hue-only grading presets, fades neutral wheels without hue rotation and follows the shortest arc between coloured wheels. Default renders are unchanged by style application code; applied styles and grading Amount behaviour change intentionally. Taste review and final validation pending.
